description: This file defines the interface for the IClientController and its accessor within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to shared memory management and client control.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of IClientController and retrieves the controller object.

classes.name: IClientController
classes.description: Defines the internal API for querying shared memory, registering, and unregistering clients.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IClientController object.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client for shared buffer change notifications and updates application state.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client from shared buffer change notifications.
